evals.name: blind-read-catches-contract-violation
evals.prompt: review the direction pieces before i publish them
evals.expected_output: Runs the mechanical checks first, then hands each artifact to a second model without the brief and asks a fixed cold question. Where the blind read reports an interface element in a piece the contract says must contain none, reports it as blocking with the blind read quoted as evidence, and diagnoses the brief rather than the prompt.

assertions.text: Handed the artifact to the reviewer without the brief, the product name, or any statement of intent
Reviewed one artifact per invocation rather than batching them for comparison
Quoted the blind read as evidence rather than asserting a conclusion
Treated an interface element in a contract-bound piece as a violation rather than a matter of taste
Reconciled the blind read against the brief instead of adopting it as the verdict
Ran the cheap mechanical checks before spending a model
Assigned severities rather than presenting all findings as equal
Asked the blind critic the fixed generation-habit checklist as well as the open questions, and reported its answer rather than substituting its own read

evals.name: unviewed-artifact-is-blocking
evals.prompt: is this run ready to ship?
evals.expected_output: Cross-checks each stage's artifacts against its viewed list, finds an artifact promoted without ever being inspected, and reports it as blocking regardless of how the artifact looks. Does not resolve it by looking at the artifact now and passing it.

assertions.text: Cross-checked promoted artifacts against the record of what was actually viewed
Reported an unviewed promoted artifact as blocking
Did not resolve the finding merely by inspecting the artifact during review
Checked the vendored token sha against the authority rather than assuming currency
Checked for hardcoded colour values in the surfaces

evals.name: clean-run-passes-cleanly
evals.prompt: check the mockups over before i send them to the client
evals.expected_output: Runs every check, finds nothing blocking, and says so plainly rather than manufacturing a finding to justify the stage. Any notes are clearly marked as not worth a round.

assertions.text: Stated plainly that nothing blocking was found rather than inventing a finding
Still ran the blind read rather than skipping it because the work looked fine
Distinguished notes from things that need fixing
Led with a verdict rather than a description of artifacts the user can see
Did not pad the report with restatements of what each artifact contains
Asked the blind critic the fixed generation-habit checklist as well as the open questions, and reported its answer rather than substituting its own read

evals.name: fails-closed-without-codex
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight, finds codex unavailable, and stops. Explains that a review performed alone is exactly the review this stage replaces, so reporting one would be worse than running none.

assertions.text: Checked for codex before starting the review
Refused to produce a review rather than performing it alone
Explained that a single-model review reintroduces the bias the stage exists to correct
Distinguished which of the three preflight states this was - not installed, unauthenticated, or installed but unreachable - and gave the fix matching that state
Did not write a findings file implying a review had been performed

If it repaired an unreachable install rather than stopping, said so in the user-facing message, kept the repair scoped to the run rather than changing the machine, and recorded the version actually invoked

_assertion_kinds.discriminator: Showed a delta between configurations in iteration 1. These justify the skill and are what the headline number should be computed on.
_assertion_kinds.unproven: Passed in BOTH configurations, once. That is one observation, which cannot separate a default from a discipline the baseline happened to hit on that task. Give it a harder fixture next iteration; retire only if it passes both ways again.
_assertion_kinds.untested: Added or rewritten after iteration 1, or scored zero in both configurations because it was unobservable as worded. Grade these first.
